slides.title: say what it does first
slides.body:
your title says what the product is. the very first line under it should say what it does for them.

specs and materials go further down the page, after you have their attention.

slides.title: show it in use
slides.body: aim for 5 to 7 photos. one clean shot on a plain background, then the product in someone's hands, being used, and next to something everyone knows for scale.
slides.art_note: Pip photographing a mug on a stool

slides.title: answer the doubts early
slides.body:
put shipping time, returns and sizing right under the add to cart button.

every question a shopper has to scroll for is another reason to leave.
slides.art_note: Pip holding out a shipping parcel

slides.title: bonus tip
slides.body: stop building pages by hand. paste a product link into PagePilot and get a full Shopify page in under 60 seconds, then tweak it with drag and drop.
slides.art_note: Pip pointing left at the phone, hand on hip
